dedupe_keys.name: cciss italian national access point for road traffic information

description: CCISS is Italy's national access point (NAP) for delegated regulation 885/2013 and related ITS regulations, and the national road traffic information service. On 2026-09-29 its home page streamed live events on motorways and main roads, for example animals on the road on the A1 Rome South branch, road works on the A16 Naples-Canosa and A1 Florence-Rome, broken-down vehicles on the Fi-Pi-Li and A10, and slow traffic on the A29, each with times and junctions. A section explains the national access point and the European regulations, and an app is offered. Coverage: Italian motorways and main roads. Format and access: web and app information, with NAP services. Licence and cost: free to consult; reuse terms not stated on the home page. Caveats: the Italian page describes the regulations but the data catalogue must be found in the NAP section. It supports network flow and emergency response studies using incident streams. It relates to the EU list of national access points and DATEX II in the catalogue.
name: CCISS: Italian national access point for road traffic information

sources.note: NAP role for 885/2013, live events on 2026-09-29, regulations section
